text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking around the
academy, I
spot Сакура Тиёно О
talking to a
worried-looking Yaeno
Muteki.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Sooo what you're saying is... you'd like
me to help
you with some singing
training?
text_block_list.name: Сакура Тиёно О

text_block_list.text:
Yes. The truth is that there's a certain
genre I just
can't seem to get the hang
of.
text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki

text_block_list.text:
Specifically... songs with, um, hints of
r-romance...
I find them
embarrassing—both to sing and listen
to.
text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki

text_block_list.text: I seeee. Love songs, huh?
text_block_list.name: Сакура Тиёно О

text_block_list.text:
However, as there's a possibility I'll have
to sing
them during a winning concert, I
can't complain!
text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki

text_block_list.text:
A win without the perfect winning
concert is
utterly unthinkable!
text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki

text_block_list.text:
Therefore I must overcome my sense of
shame, no
matter the cost!
text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki

text_block_list.text:
I can endure all manner of training. So,
please, I
beg of you!
text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki

text_block_list.text:
All right, I'll do it! It's just like they
always say,
there's no such thing as a
free win!
text_block_list.name: Сакура Тиёно О

text_block_list.text:
Okay, let's start by having you read the
lyrics
aloud. That way, you can gradually
get used to
them!
text_block_list.name: Сакура Тиёно О

text_block_list.text: O-osu! Ahem, here I go, then!
text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki

text_block_list.text:
"The moment you leave, I f-feel so
a-alone... The
warmth of y-you... The
warmth of y-your hand?
Is... so..."
text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki

text_block_list.text: Hngh!
text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki

text_block_list.text: Are you all right?!
text_block_list.name: Сакура Тиёно О

text_block_list.text:
W-well, it's j-just... these lyrics are... so
much
more intense than I was expecting!
text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki

text_block_list.text:
Should we stop?! Don't push yourself
too hard!
text_block_list.name: Сакура Тиёно О

text_block_list.text:
N-no! Backing down now would be akin
to failing
altogether!
text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki

text_block_list.text:
"If I-I had t-told you... I l-l-loooooved
you...
b-back then"... Ngh!
text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki

text_block_list.text:
...If I had formally proposed a
relationship...
perhaps our future
would've been different...
Maybe not,
though...
text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki

text_block_list.text:
Come on, Yaeno! You can't change the
lyrics!
text_block_list.name: Сакура Тиёно О

text_block_list.text:
"I know what it's like to be... t-to be
l-l-l-lonely..."
text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki

text_block_list.text:
Oh, how helpless the heart of a maiden
can be
when she seeks to open it and
reveal the emotion
within...
text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki

text_block_list.text:
It sounds like you're reciting classical
poetry now!
text_block_list.name: Сакура Тиёно О

text_block_list.text:
A few words alone can carry greater
weight than a
mountain, and depth
greater than even the
ocean.
text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki

text_block_list.text:
You do not know, my beloved, that
there is no
one else for me but you...
text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki

text_block_list.text: ...And you're done, right?
text_block_list.name: Сакура Тиёно О

text_block_list.text:
M-my deepest apologies! I succumbed
to my old
habits. I have failed...
text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki

text_block_list.text:
No, wait... I actually think it's okay to do
it your
own way!
text_block_list.name: Сакура Тиёно О

text_block_list.text: Huh?
text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki

text_block_list.text: Sure, the lyrics are a little formal, but that's what makes them so you!
text_block_list.name: Сакура Тиёно О

text_block_list.text:
It reminds me of a saying I once heard!
"Different
cleats for different feets"!
text_block_list.name: Сакура Тиёно О

text_block_list.text:
Instead of trying to overcome it, you
should
embrace your unique singing
style! That's the way
to do it!
text_block_list.name: Сакура Тиёно О

text_block_list.text: Chiyono O! I am in your debt!
text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki

text_block_list.text:
...Indeed, the classical poems I've come
to cherish
also express deep-seated
feelings in vivid detail.
text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki

text_block_list.text:
Be it a love song or an old poem, the
emotions
expressed are not all that
different.
text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki

text_block_list.text: With that in mind, all I need to do... is take to the stage and fully express myself as I am!
text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki

text_block_list.text:
It is indeed as you said. If I have more
confidence
in myself as I practice... I'm
certain I will become a
great singer.
text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki

text_block_list.text:
To that end, I must learn and experience
more
still! I will not stop until I've
mastered all the
ancient poems!
text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki

text_block_list.text:
Uh, no?! You're changing your goal a
little there,
Yaeno!
text_block_list.name: Сакура Тиёно О

text_block_list.text:
A gleaming grin spreads across Yaeno
Muteki's
face, as if the clouds hanging
over her have
parted.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
...At any rate, it looks like Yaeno Muteki
feels a
bit more confident singing love
songs now.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
